text:
maya: Quick sketch dump for the model catalog compare — trying a 'dense' results mode + a small legend for badges. Figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-dense (frame: dense-v1). Would love quick feedback on wording and keyboard flow.

sam: Nice! Dense mode feels right for power users. Two calls out: 1) badge colors: legend needed. right now green = 'fast' but users read green = safe/verified. 2) show metric unit and percentile: e.g., '14 ms (p95)'.

elena: Accessibility: contrast on the tiny latency chips in dark theme is low. Also the dense rows pack multiple buttons; SR users will have many tab stops. Consider a single row expander/menu to reduce tabbing.

rui: a11y extras: when toggling dense view announce `role="status" aria-live="polite"` "Switched to dense view". For the badge legend, use an accessible list with `role="list"` and labels. And please make the version control action keyboard-focusable (not just a hover target).

omar: Product thought: some customers want to "freeze" a version so their routes never move. Proposed rename from Pin/Lock -> Freeze version. Copy: button: "Freeze version"; toast: "Version v3.1 frozen for Analytics workspace — undo". calling it Freeze might reduce ambiguity with pin metaphors.

sam: "Freeze" could be ok but may sound irreversible. Maybe microcopy: "Freeze (can be unfrozen)"? Or use tooltip explaining undo.

elena: Whatever we call it, aria-live should clearly say action and workspace: "Frozen v3.1 for Analytics workspace". And on undo announce "Unfrozen v3.1". Also ensure toast has role="status" so SR picks it up.

rui: keyboard shortcut requests: `/` to focus global search, `f` to toggle filter focus, and `x` to jump to pinned/frozen items. If we add shortcuts, include a small help modal with role="dialog". Track `compare.shortcuts_shown` telemetry.

sam: visual tweak: show a tiny legend pill above table: "Perf: bolt icon. Verified: star. Cost: ¢". Legend items should be tabbable so keyboard users can read tooltips.

omar: UX flow: when a user freezes a version, surface it in the compare sort (frozen items first) and add a subtle 2px outline + badge 'Frozen'. Also include a workspace-level setting: "Auto-apply frozen versions on import" (opt-in).

elena: Contrast note: use 14px semibold for small numeric badges to hit AA. For dark theme pick bg #081029 with text #e9f2ff or adjust to meet 4.5:1.

maya: Great — summary action items: 1) add badge legend + tabbable legend tooltips (sam) 2) decide naming: Freeze vs Lock (product to decide; omar/maya to propose final copy) 3) aria-live to announce view toggles + freeze/unfreeze (rui/elena) 4) single-row action menu to reduce tab stops (elena) 5) keyboard-help modal + telemetry (rui/sam) 6) contrast bump for numeric badges (sam/elena) 7) place frozen items at top + outline + 'Frozen' badge (omar)

design-bot: Figma frame 'dense-v1' updated by maya. Labels: design-review, dense-mode, accessibility.

maya: thanks! i'll iterate on copy (leaning toward "Freeze" with undo microcopy) and push updated frames. please leave any last thoughts here before EOD. :thumbsup:
